jobs.title: Compliance Analyst (LATAM)
jobs.summary: About Reap Reap is a global financial technology company headquartered in Hong Kong with employees across multiple countries. We enable financial connectivity and access for businesses worldwide by combining traditional finance with stablecoins for efficient money movement. Through our stablecoin-powered corporate cards, payments, and expense management tools, we streamline financial operations and help businesses scale. Our APIs enable businesses to integrate stablecoin-enabled finance into their own products and services—from issuing Visa cards to facilitating cross-border payments. As part of the Payward group of companies, Reap is building the future of borderless, stablecoin-enabled finance. The Role Reap is looking for a Compliance Analyst (AML/CFT) to support the execution of our Mexico entity's compliance program. The Compliance Analyst will play a key role within Reap's Compliance function in Mexico, supporting the Compliance Officer in the implementation and day-to-day execution of Reap's Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Financing of Terrorism (AML/CFT — PLD/FT) compliance program. This position will focus on handling regulatory authority requests through SITI AA, responding to the CNBV's Operational Questionnaire (Cuestionario de Operatividad), and supporting internal and external audits, CNBV inspection visits, and Visa reviews, all of which are a core priority for the entity. It is a great fit for someone who demonstrates rigor in managing regulatory deadlines, discipline in documentation, and absolute confidentiality in handling client information and authority requests. This person will communicate and escalate matters to the Compliance Officer in a timely manner, ensuring operational excellence in a regulated, fast-paced environment with a strong focus on audit-ready evidence and professional ethics. What you'll do Authority requests (SITI AA) Receive, register, and follow up on official requests (oficios) and information requirements from authorities (CNBV, UIF, FGR, judicial and administrative authorities) notified through SITI AA. Analyze the scope of each requirement, gather the requested information and documentation (client files, transactional data, supporting evidence), and prepare draft responses for the Compliance Officer's review. Monitor response deadlines, upload responses and acknowledgments in SITI AA, and maintain a complete, audit-ready log and file of all authority requests. Support the handling of other CNBV and SAT requirements (information requests, clarifications, and observations). Operational Questionnaire (Cuestionario de Operatividad) Support the response to the CNBV's Operational Questionnaire by gathering and consolidating the required operational and transactional information from the relevant areas. Prepare the draft response for the Compliance Officer's review and validation prior to submission, and safeguard the evidence of filing. Audit management Support the entity's internal and external AML/CFT audits and CNBV inspection visits by gathering information, consolidating evidence, and following up on auditors' requests. Support Visa audits, including evidence preparation and follow-up on observations. Track remediation plans and the closure of findings, keeping the status updated for the Compliance Officer. Compliance program support Support the preparation of the Compliance Officer's monthly minutes and reports. Participate in the update of the Compliance Manual, risk matrices, and internal policies. Support the logistics and evidence of the annual AML/CFT training programs. Maintain the safekeeping and retention of documentation in accordance with regulatory timeframes. What we're looking for 2–3 years of experience in compliance, preferably within the financial services industry. Bachelor's degree in a field related to Compliance: Law, Accounting, Administration, or similar. Strong teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Strong ethical record and behavior. Analytical skills, with the ability to assess and mitigate compliance risks by transforming them into key objective metrics. High attention to detail, especially around regulatory deadlines, evidence, and audit trails. Knowledge of Mexico's AML/CFT framework (LGOAAC, the General Provisions applicable to money transmitters, and the LFPIORPI); familiarity with SITI AA. Advanced English. What success looks like In the first 3–6 months, this person will help strengthen the structure, timeliness, and visibility of the compliance program by: Keeping 100% of authority requests and requirements answered within the applicable deadlines, with a complete, audit-ready log and file. Ensuring the Operational Questionnaire is answered on time, with validated information and safeguarded evidence of filing. Improving the organization of audit evidence (AML/CFT, CNBV, and Visa) and the visibility of the status of observations and remediation plans. Creating and maintaining clear trackers of regulatory deadlines, requirements, and pending items for the Compliance Officer. Strengthening the documentation and safekeeping of the compliance program (minutes, manual, training). About the role This is a hands-on execution role for someone who is structured, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable working under the direction of the Compliance Officer and in coordination with other areas. The ideal candidate turns regulatory requirements into well-organized responses, complete files, and timely follow-ups, operating with strong ownership. If you are excited about regulatory compliance and the opportunity to grow within a regulated entity in a fast-moving environment, we'd love to hear from you. Why You'll Love It Here A high-impact role in a rapidly growing fintech company Flexible work environment with a global, collaborative team Insurance coverage after probation Reap Card stipend Use of AI tools at work, and the space to learn, experiment, and grow with them A culture of innovation, inclusion, and continuous learning After submitting your application, please check your inbox for a confirmation email. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Client Activation (B2B Onboarding, KYC/KYB)
jobs.summary: About Reap Reap is a global financial technology company headquartered in Hong Kong with employees across multiple countries. We enable financial connectivity and access for businesses worldwide by combining traditional finance with stablecoins for efficient money movement. Through our stablecoin-powered corporate cards, payments, and expense management tools, we streamline financial operations and help businesses scale. Our APIs enable businesses to integrate stablecoin-enabled finance into their own products and services—from issuing Visa cards to facilitating cross-border payments. Backed by leading investors including Index Ventures and HashKey Capital, Reap is building the future of borderless, stablecoin-enabled finance. Role Overview We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own and scale Reap's client activation and onboarding experience as we expand into new markets and unlock new use cases. Client Activation is the company's #1 objective - this role sits at the centre of it. You will design onboarding that turns regulatory complexity into a competitive advantage: fast, compliant, consistent client activation across geographies, products, and flow types, built on systems that scale and differentiate Reap in the market. What You'll Do End-to-end activation funnels - from application through identity verification, KYC/KYB, AML screening, risk assessment, account setup, and first value. Our core motion is B2B, with consumer use cases alongside it. The verification and AML stack in-product - identity and entity verification (KYC/KYB), document and registry checks, sanctions and PEP screening, risk decisioning, and controls that keep us audit-ready across jurisdictions. Vendor and orchestration strategy - select, integrate, and get the most out of KYC/KYB providers, identity verification vendors, and workflow engines. Scalable onboarding architecture - configurable flows, rules, and decisioning that adapt to jurisdiction-specific requirements without bespoke rebuilds, plus the activation playbook that lets Reap enter new markets and launch new use cases faster each time. Regulatory-by-design product thinking - partner deeply with Compliance and Legal to translate licensing and regulatory obligations into product requirements that don't compromise client experience. Cross-functional orchestration - partner closely with Engineering day-to-day, and work across Ops, Compliance, and GTM to remove friction, reduce manual review, and improve conversion and time-to-activate. Metrics and iteration - own activation funnel metrics (conversion, time-to-activation, verification speed, manual review rates, drop-off by stage and market), run experiments, and drive a roadmap grounded in data. What We’re Looking For Built B2B onboarding/activation systems in regulated fintech - hands-on PM experience shipping client onboarding, KYC/KYB, or activation products. You will own the reliability of a payments platform while rebuilding the foundation it runs on — the lights stay on while the platform gets replaced underneath them. We treat repetitive manual work as a bug in the platform, not a chore for a human, and your job is to delete whole categories of it rather than absorb them faster. Define what reliability means here: set SLIs and SLOs with product and engineering teams, introduce error budgets, and make "ship or stabilise?" a matter of arithmetic rather than argument Take part We enable financial connectivity and access for businesses worldwide by combining traditional finance with stablecoins for efficient money movement. Through our stablecoin-powered corporate cards, payments, and expense management tools, we streamline financial operations and help businesses scale. Our APIs enable businesses to integrate stablecoin-enabled finance into their own products and services—from issuing Visa cards to facilitating cross-border payments. As part of the Payward group of companies, Reap is building the future of borderless, stablecoin-enabled finance. Why Reap? The Treasury team builds and operates the engine underneath every Reap product — the core infrastructure that moves money across our platform. Incoming and outgoing flows, fiat and stablecoins, wallets and custody, internal transfers, withdrawals, and payouts. These systems have to be reliable, observable, and audit-ready by default, because everything else at Reap depends on them being right. As Engineering Manager, Treasury, you'll lead the team building global, asset-agnostic money movement systems that work across regions, currencies, and financial partners. A significant part of the work is wallet infrastructure — integrating custody and wallet providers, and designing the key management, signing, and reconciliation flows that sit around them. You'll be deeply involved in the architecture and operation of those systems while developing the engineers around you. You'll partner closely with the Head of Treasury and Reap's product organization to turn treasury strategy into systems that actually hold up in production. Your Mission Awaits Primary Mandate Own the engineering side of the Treasury domain — assets and currencies, rails and networks, FX, wallet and account infrastructure, and the global ledger — building the foundation that lets Reap launch new hubs and markets Lead the design, development, and operation of core treasury systems, staying hands-on enough in the architecture to make and defend real technical decisions Lead wallet and custody integrations end to end, from provider evaluation and key management design through to production operation and reconciliation Develop a deep understanding of Reap's clients, product suite, and hubs, and use it to make opinionated, well-reasoned technical calls Be part of Reap's engineering leadership, helping build the foundational systems that power Reap's ambitions Cross-Functional Leadership Work closely with product, engineering, design, finance, customer success, and business operations to drive outcomes across Reap's global hubs Communicate technical decisions, rationale, and tradeoffs clearly to company leadership and key stakeholders Grow and shape the Treasury engineering team — hiring, operating model, and long-term roadmap Drive technical decision-making while supporting the growth and performance of the engineers on your team Technology & Systems Craft Define and build systems that compound in capability and scale, and that can be orchestrated across all of Reap's global hubs Build observability into every layer; lead incident response and drive continuous reliability improvements Define and measure success metrics for continuous improvement, using data to get 1% better every day Maintain a high bar for quality — you care about the details of how something works and scales, not just whether the v1 shipped Stay current with fintech, infrastructure, and compliance trends, and evolve our systems accordingly AI-Augmented Ways of Working Actively use AI tooling to accelerate your own output — design exploration, code review, debugging, spec writing, and technical synthesis Help embed AI-native practices across the team; you raise the bar for what good looks like Identify opportunities to build AI-assisted capabilities into the systems themselves, not just your personal workflow What We Are Looking For We encourage everyone to apply even if you just meet the must-haves. The rest is a bonus. Must-Have Experience: Minimum of 8 years of software engineering experience in treasuries, ledgers, or FX, with at least 1-2 years in technical leadership or management roles. Proven track record of owning and operating business-critical systems. Wallet infrastructure: Working understanding of crypto wallet architecture — custodial and non-custodial models, key management, address lifecycle, and signing flows — and experience integrating wallet or custody providers in production Domain fluency: Broad functional fluency across the finance stack — virtual assets, fiat currencies, blockchains, payment networks, ledgers, and partners/counterparties API-driven systems: Experience building API-driven global financial systems — you can read specs, evaluate integration designs, and write precise API-level requirements Problem solving: You care deeply about correctness, edge cases, and failure modes. You approach problems methodically, debug with rigor, and prioritize clear, robust solutions over quick fixes. Engineering breadth: Deep backend experience and a genuine interest in financial infrastructure, without being bounded by stack lines. You work across layers to solve the right problem. Technical judgment: You balance technical depth with product understanding and apply sound judgment to tradeoffs. You build systems that are elegant under the hood but practical and adaptable in real-world use. Written communication: Your design docs, memos, and specs are clear, well-structured, and stand on their own Peer collaboration: You hold a high bar for code quality, reliability, and peer review, and value working with others who do the same. You communicate clearly, challenge ideas respectfully, and raise the quality of the whole team. You thrive in high-velocity, ambiguous environments, have a roll-up-your-sleeves mentality, and are comfortable running multiple workstreams with competing deadlines Our main stack is TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, and AWS, but we value strong engineering fundamentals over any specific toolset Nice to Have Technical proficiency: You design systems that are stateless by default, built for scale, and resilient to failure. Deeper wallet and custody work: Experience with MPC or HSM-backed signing, multi-chain address management, or running self-custody infrastructure at scale Embedded finance: Experience supporting B2B and B2C clients with financial infrastructure Full-stack experience: Experience across backend, frontend, infrastructure, and data AI tooling: Experience building or prototyping AI-assisted internal tooling High-growth environments: Experience working in high-growth teams Desired Attributes Independently driven — you identify what matters, form a view, and pursue it without waiting to be directed Opinionated but intellectually honest — you bring strong views and defend them clearly, but update when you encounter better information or arguments Broad domain curiosity — you're as comfortable in an FX spread discussion as in a debate about ledger design or a new counterparty integration; you connect dots others miss Systems thinker — you see your domain as part of a larger interconnected system and make decisions accordingly High ownership, low ego — you take accountability for outcomes, escalate early when things are stuck, and don't need credit to stay motivated AI-native, not AI-curious — you've moved past wondering what AI can do and are actively building your own workflows, prompts, and systems around it Why You'll Love It Here A high-impact role in a rapidly growing fintech company Flexible work environment with a global, collaborative team — fully remote for EMEA, hybrid for Hong Kong and Singapore Insurance coverage after probation Reap Card stipend Use of AI tools at work, and the space to learn, experiment, and grow with them A culture of innovation, inclusion, and continuous learning After submitting your application, please check your inbox for a confirmation email. You are responsible for driving the end-to-end consolidation timeline and holding the team accountable. Manage and develop the business line reporting team, overseeing the Finance Managers / Senior Financial Analysts who own individual business lines. Provide technical guidance, review their work, and ensure consistency in methodology and quality across the group. Own the group consolidation workpapers, including intercompany eliminations, foreign currency translation, tiered sub-consolidation and top-level Reap Group consolidation. Ensure all elimination entries are complete and reconciled. Drive the month-end and quarter-end close calendar, setting deadlines, tracking progress, and resolving bottlenecks. Continuously improve the close timeline and reduce the number of days to close. Ensure consistency and accuracy of reporting across all entities, establishing and enforcing group accounting policies, chart of accounts standards, and reporting templates. Harmonise the treatment of complex items (multi-currency transactions, stablecoin accounting, intercompany pricing) across jurisdictions.
